description: Renovate proposes an update for every pin it can read; nothing merges without the maintainer's review (Decision 0014). Landed held: every update waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard until ticket 44 activates the app, except a vulnerability fix, such as one osvVulnerabilityAlerts below raises: Renovate opens those without approval by default, and they still never merge themselves.

packageRules.description: Hex packages in one pull request, with a major update in one of its own (separateMajorMinor). An in-range update moves manifest.toml only; an update outside a range moves the range in gleam.toml as well, and Renovate runs gleam to rewrite manifest.toml.

Every action pinned by SHA, and the runner labels, in one group, which Renovate still splits: a major update gets a pull request of its own (separateMajorMinor). An action's SHA and its version comment move together.

The nixpkgs pin, and flake.lock's maintenance, waits for approval: one revision moves the compiler, OTP and every other tool at once, and both images with them, so each update is approved, read with `just tool-versions` before and after, and run through the gate (Decision 0017). Rewriting flake.lock means running nix, an execution the hosted app has not been shown to allow.

The local-cluster images move together and wait for approval. kind, kustomize and helm move with the nixpkgs pin, and kubectl by hand in nix/kubectl.nix; scripts/checks/tests/test_dependency_pins.py holds kubectl within one minor of the node image.
Kubernetes 1.35 until the vendored schemas move: scripts/schemas/kubernetes is 1.35. kubectl 1.36 reaches 1.35 to 1.37.
etcd 3.6 until the cluster moves: kwok 0.8 runs Kubernetes 1.35 on etcd 3.6, and etcd 3.7 is not that pairing.

The kwok controller image moves only by hand, with the kwokctl the nixpkgs pin carries: both name one kwok release, and scripts/checks/tests/test_dependency_pins.py fails until they agree (Decision 0017).

KEDA moves only by hand: fixtures/keda_e2e/keda.json pins the release's core YAML by sha256 and the two images it names by digest, and all three move together. No manager reads that file today, and no bot can rehash the YAML, so this keeps any later one off it (ticket 33).

The local observability stack moves only by hand: fixtures/observability/stack.json pins the prometheus and grafana chart archives by sha256 and the three images their renders name by multi-arch index digest, and all of them move together. No manager reads that file today, and no bot can rehash a chart, so this keeps any later one off it (ticket 51).

customManagers.description: The kind node image and the kwok control-plane images in the cluster adapter, each a string literal name:tag@sha256:digest.
